pages.menu_path: About Us > Our History > Our History
pages.title: Our History
pages.text_en:
The Meru District Council was officially established by Government Notice No. 353 of 2007 following the decision to divide the former Arumeru District Council and create two independent district councils: Meru District Council and Arusha District Council .
Meru District Council is located in the eastern part of the Arusha Region and lies between latitude 36°43’16’’ and 37°03’43’’ , and longitude -3°04’30’’ .
Meru District Council borders Longido District to the north ; Siha and Hai Districts to the east (in Kilimanjaro Region ); Simanjiro District to the south (in Manyara Region ); and Arusha District and Arusha District Council to the west .
pages.text_sw:
Halmashauri ya wilaya ya Meru imeanzishwa rasmi kwa Tangazo la serikali Namba 353 ya mwaka 2007 kufuatia uamuzi wa kugawa iliyokuwa Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Arumeru na kuanzisha Halmashauri mbili za Wilaya zinazojitegemea za Meru na Arusha
Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Meru ipo Mashariki mwa mkoa wa Arusha na imelala kati ya latitudi 36o43’16’’ na 37o 03’43’’; na Longitudi -3o04’30’’Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Meru inapakana na Wilaya ya Longido kwa upande wa Kaskazini, Wilaya za Siha na Hai kwa upande wa Mashariki (Mkoa wa Kilimanjaro), Wilaya ya Simanjiro kwa upande wa Kusini (Mkoa wa Manyara), na Wilaya ya Arusha na Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Arusha kwa upande wa Magharibi.

pages.title: Mission and Vision
pages.text_en:
Vision of Meru District Council is:
“A well-educated, food-secure medium-income community anchored on agro-based industries and eco-tourism by 2025.”
This Vision reflects the Council’s commitment to fostering education, food security, economic empowerment, and sustainable utilization of natural resources. It emphasizes the role of agro-based industries and eco-tourism as key drivers of local economic growth. However, given that 2025 has passed, the Vision provides an important reference point for assessing progress and shaping the new long-term direction aligned with Vision 2050, which emphasizes inclusivity, prosperity, technological advancement, and sustainable growth.
Mission of the Council is:
“To empower communities to innovatively and sustainably use available resources to attain medium-income status by 2025.”
The Mission underscores the Council’s focus on community empowerment, innovation, and sustainable resource management. It highlights the importance of equipping communities to participate actively in economic development and improving livelihoods. In reviewing this Mission, it is clear that while significant progress has been made toward achieving medium-income status, emerging challenges and new opportunities—particularly in technology adoption, industrial diversification, and climate resilience—necessitate updating the Mission to align with long-term strategic objectives and the Council’s new Vision.
pages.text_sw:
Dira ya Halmashauri ni:
“Jamii yenye elimu bora, yenye uhakika wa chakula na yenye kipato cha kati, inayotegemea viwanda vinavyotumia mazao ya kilimo na utalii wa ikolojia ifikapo mwaka 2031.”
Dira hii inaakisi dhamira ya Halmashauri katika kuimarisha elimu, usalama wa chakula, uwezeshaji wa kiuchumi, na matumizi endelevu ya rasilimali za asili. Pia inasisitiza umuhimu wa viwanda vinavyotumia mazao ya kilimo na utalii wa ikolojia kama vichocheo muhimu vya ukuaji wa uchumi wa eneo husika. Hata hivyo, kutokana na kwamba mwaka 2025 tayari umepita, Dira hii inatoa rejea muhimu katika kutathmini maendeleo yaliyofikiwa na kusaidia kuunda mwelekeo mpya wa muda mrefu unaoendana na Dira ya Taifa ya Maendeleo 2050 , ambayo inasisitiza ujumuishi, ustawi wa jamii, maendeleo ya teknolojia, na ukuaji endelevu.
Dhima ya Halmashauri ni:
“Kuwezesha jamii kutumia rasilimali zilizopo kwa ubunifu na kwa njia endelevu ili kufikia hadhi ya kipato cha kati ifikapo mwaka 2031.”
Dhima hii inaonyesha msisitizo wa Halmashauri katika kuwezesha jamii, kuhimiza ubunifu, na kusimamia rasilimali kwa njia endelevu. Inasisitiza umuhimu wa kuzijengea jamii uwezo wa kushiriki kikamilifu katika maendeleo ya kiuchumi na kuboresha maisha yao. Katika kupitia upya Dhima hii, inaonekana kuwa licha ya mafanikio yaliyopatikana katika kufikia hadhi ya kipato cha kati, changamoto mpya na fursa zinazoibuka—hasa katika matumizi ya teknolojia, utofauti wa viwanda, na ustahimilivu dhidi ya mabadiliko ya tabianchi—zinahitaji Dhima hiyo kuboreshwa ili iendane na malengo ya muda mrefu ya kimkakati na Dira mpya ya Halmashauri.

pages.title: Core Values
pages.text_en:
Core Values
The Core Values that underpin the Vision and Mission include integrity, teamwork, transparency, accountability, and innovativeness. These values provide guidance for the behavior and decision making of Council staff and stakeholders, ensuring that the Council delivers services effectively, equitably, and sustainably.
pages.text_sw:
Maadili Msingi yanayounga mkono Dira na Dhima ni pamoja na uadilifu, ushirikiano (kazi ya pamoja), uwazi, uwajibikaji, na ubunifu .
Maadili haya yanatoa mwongozo kwa mienendo na maamuzi ya watumishi wa Halmashauri pamoja na wadau wake, ili kuhakikisha kuwa Halmashauri inatoa huduma kwa ufanisi, usawa, na kwa njia endelevu .

pages.menu_path: About Us > Strategic Plan > Strategic Plan
pages.title: Strategic Plan
pages.text_en:
Strategic Plan (2025/2026 – 2029/2030)
Introduction
This Five-Year Strategic Plan (2025/2026 – 2029/2030) has been prepared to guide the Meru District Council in fulfilling its Vision and Mission through the sustainable delivery of quality social and economic services to citizens.
The plan is designed to accelerate economic growth, strengthen good governance, and promote inclusive and sustainable development.
Strategic Focus Areas
This plan focuses on the following key areas:
Increasing productivity in agriculture and livestock through improved extension services and the adoption of modern farming techniques.
Expanding rural infrastructure , including rural roads, water supply projects, and schools/health facilities.
Strengthening community financial systems , particularly Savings and Credit Cooperative Societies (SACCOS) and small business cooperatives.
Empowering women and youth through income-generating programs and entrepreneurship training.
Addressing climate change through mitigation and adaptation measures in agriculture, water management, and natural resource management.
Improving financial management and accountability by strengthening systems, transparency, and internal auditing.
Investing in human resources through continuous capacity building, recruitment, and professional development of council staff.
Providing quality social services , including education, health, water, and environmental sanitation.
Promoting good governance as the foundation for peace, justice, security, and sustainable social and economic development
pages.text_sw:
Mpango Mkakati (2025/2026 – 2029/2030)
Utangulizi
Mpango huu wa Miaka Mitano ya Mkakati (2025/2026 – 2029/2031) umeandaliwa kuongoza Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Meru katika kutimiza Dira na Dhima yake kupitia utoaji endelevu wa huduma bora za kijamii na kiuchumi kwa wananchi. Mpango huu umebuniwa ili kuharakisha ukuaji wa uchumi, kuendeleza utawala bora, na kuhimiza maendeleo jumuishi na endelevu .
Eneo la Mkakati
Mpango huu unalenga kwenye maeneo muhimu yafuatayo:
Kuongeza tija katika kilimo na ufugaji kupitia huduma za ugani zilizoimarishwa na mbinu za kisasa.
Kupanua miundombinu ya vijijini , ikiwemo barabara za vijijini, miradi ya maji, na shule/hospitali.
Kuimarisha mifumo ya kifedha ya kijamii , hasa SACCOS na ushirika wa biashara ndogo ndogo.
Kuwezesha wanawake na vijana kupitia programu za kuongeza kipato na mafunzo ya ujasiriamali.
Kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya tabianchi kupitia hatua za kupunguza madhara na kuendana nayo katika kilimo, maji, na usimamizi wa rasilimali asilia.
Kuboresha usimamizi wa fedha na uwajibikaji kwa kuimarisha mifumo, uwazi, na ukaguzi wa ndani.
Kuwekeza katika rasilimali watu kupitia uboreshaji endelevu wa uwezo, uajiri, na maendeleo ya kitaaluma ya wafanyakazi wa halmashauri.
Kutoa huduma bora za kijamii , ikiwemo elimu, afya, maji, na usafi wa mazingira.
Kukuza utawala bora kama msingi wa amani, haki, usalama, na maendeleo endelevu ya kijamii na kiuchumi.

pages.title: Division of Administration and Human Resource Management
pages.text_en:
The Department of Administration and Human Resource Management in Meru District Council has been an important link in managing human resources, establishing good governance systems, and ensuring that public servants provide quality services to citizens while adhering to work ethics, efficiency, and accountability.
Main Functions of the Department of Administration and Human Resources
Human Resource Management:
Preparing employment requirements according to the needs of departments.
Conducting recruitment processes in accordance with approval from TAMISEMI and the Public Service Recruitment Secretariat .
Monitoring employees’ performance at work and maintaining their records.
Coordination of Staff Training:
Preparing short-term and long-term training plans.
Monitoring employees who are pursuing studies.
Facilitating professional development and work efficiency.
Management of Workplace Discipline:
Handling disciplinary matters of employees in accordance with Public Service Regulations .
Providing guidelines on discipline, ethics, and integrity at the workplace.
Facilitating Internal Communication:
Managing daily activities in the office of the Director.
Coordinating management meetings, council meetings of councillors, and standing committee meetings.
Management of Security, Protection and Protocol:
Coordinating activities of office security guards.
Coordinating the reception of national leaders and various visitors.
Office, Records and Postal Management:
Managing the system of receiving and distributing correspondence.
Keeping council records and documents.
Supervising the receipt of office supplies and maintaining the cleanliness of buildings.
Improvement of the Working Environment:
Facilitating cleaning services, office maintenance, and creating a conducive working environment for effective job performance.
Sections within the Department of Administration and Human Resources
This department is divided into four (4) main sections , each with specific responsibilities:
1. Public Service Section
Coordinates new recruitment, transfers, promotions, confirmation of employees in service, and retirement benefits.
Manages the Human Resource Management Information System (HRMIS) database.
Coordinates Performance Evaluation and Performance Management Information System (PEPMIS) .
2. Training and Staff Development Section
Coordinates professional training programs.
Manages long-term and short-term studies.
Issues training permits and coordinates the return of employees after completing their studies.
3. Office Administration Section
Manages office services such as cleanliness, security, reception, and document distribution.
Coordinates operational activities of the Director’s Office.
Ensures proper management of documents and office equipment.
4. Security, Protocol and Internal Communication Section
Coordinates the reception of leaders and official visitors.
Manages council protocol matters.
Oversees the security of government buildings.
pages.text_sw:
Idara ya Utawala na usimamizi wa Rasilimali watu, katika Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Meru imekuwa kiungo muhimu katika kusimamia rasilimali watu, kuweka mifumo ya utawala bora, na kuhakikisha watumishi wa umma wanatoa huduma bora kwa wananchi kwa kuzingatia maadili ya kazi, ufanisi, na uwajibikaji.
Majukumu Makuu ya Idara ya Utawala na Utumishi
Usimamizi wa Rasilimali Watu: Kuandaa mahitaji ya ajira kulingana na mahitaji ya idara.
Kuendesha mchakato wa ajira mpya kwa mujibu wa kibali kutoka TAMISEMI na Sekretarieti ya Ajira.
Kufuatilia maendeleo ya watumishi kazini na kuhifadhi taarifa zao.
Kuratibu Mafunzo kwa Watumishi: Kuandaa mipango ya mafunzo ya muda mfupi na mrefu.
Kufuatilia watumishi waliopo masomoni.
Kuwezesha uboreshaji wa taaluma na ufanisi kazini.
Kusimamia Nidhamu Kazini: Kushughulikia masuala ya kinidhamu ya watumishi kwa mujibu wa Kanuni za Utumishi wa Umma.
Kutoa miongozo ya nidhamu, maadili, na uadilifu kazini.
Kurahisisha Mawasiliano ya Ndani: Kusimamia shughuli za kila siku katika ofisi ya Mkurugenzi.
Kuratibu vikao vya menejimenti, baraza la madiwani na vikao vya kamati za kudumu.
Usimamizi wa Usalama, Ulinzi na Itifaki: Kuratibu shughuli za walinzi wa ofisi.
Kuratibu mapokezi ya viongozi wa kitaifa na wageni mbalimbali.
Usimamizi wa Ofisi, Nyaraka na Posta: Kusimamia mfumo wa mapokezi na usambazaji wa barua.
Kuhifadhi kumbukumbu na nyaraka za halmashauri.
Kusimamia upokeaji wa vifaa na usafi wa majengo.
Kusimamia Uboreshaji wa Mazingira ya Kazi: Kuwezesha huduma za usafi, matengenezo ya ofisi, na mazingira rafiki kwa utendaji bora wa kazi.
Seksheni Zilizopo Kwenye Idara ya Utawala na Utumishi
Idara hii imegawanyika katika seksheni kuu nne (4) , kila moja ikiwa na majukumu maalum:
1. Seksheni ya Utumishi wa Umma
Inaratibu ajira mpya, uhamisho, upandishaji vyeo, uthibitisho kazini, na mafao ya kustaafu.
Inasimamia kanzidata ya taarifa za watumishi (HRMIS).
Inaratibu tathmini ya utendaji kazi (PEPMIS).
2. Seksheni ya Mafunzo na Maendeleo ya Watumishi
Inaratibu mipango ya mafunzo ya kitaaluma.
Inasimamia masomo ya muda mrefu na wa muda mfupi.
Hutoa vibali vya mafunzo na kuratibu marejeo ya watumishi waliomaliza masomo.
3. Seksheni ya Utawala wa Ofisi
Inasimamia huduma za kiofisi kama usafi, ulinzi, mapokezi na usambazaji wa nyaraka.
Inaratibu shughuli za uendeshaji wa ofisi ya mkurugenzi.
Inahakikisha utunzaji wa nyaraka na vifaa vya ofisi.
4. Seksheni ya Usalama, Itifaki na Mawasiliano ya Ndani
Inaratibu mapokezi ya viongozi na wageni rasmi.
Inasimamia itifaki za halmashauri.
Inashughulikia ulinzi wa majengo ya serikali.

pages.menu_path: Administration > Division > Division of Planning and Coordination
pages.title: Division of Planning and Coordination
pages.text_en:
Main Objective
To provide expertise and services in planning, budgeting, monitoring, and evaluating the implementation of plans.
Specific Objectives
(i) To prepare medium-term and long-term strategies, plans, and budgets.
(ii) To monitor and evaluate the implementation of strategies, plans, and budgets.
(iii) To prepare and review the economic profile of the Council.
(iv) To coordinate the implementation of private sector participation.
(v) To coordinate the collection, analysis, interpretation, and storage of statistics within the Council.
(vi) To provide professional advice on the monitoring and evaluation process.
(vii) To coordinate the Council’s Disaster Management activities.
(viii) To coordinate Council activities implemented by other institutions, such as the land sector.
pages.text_sw:
Lengo Kuu
Kutoa utaalamu na huduma katika kupanga, kuandaa bajeti, kufuatilia na kutathmini utekelezaji wa mipango.
Malengo Mahususi
(i) Kuandaa mikakati, mipango na bajeti ya muda wa kati na muda mrefu.
(ii) Kufuatilia na kutathmini utekelezaji wa mikakati, mipango na bajeti.
(iii) Kuandaa na kupitia wasifu wa kiuchumi wa Halmashauri.
(iv) Kuratibu utekelezaji wa ushiriki wa sekta binafsi.
(v) Kuratibu ukusanyaji, uchambuzi, ufafanuzi na uhifadhi wa takwimu katika Halmashauri.
(vi) Kutoa ushauri wa kitaalamu kuhusu mchakato wa ufuatiliaji na tathmini.
(vii) Kuratibu shughuli za Menejimenti ya Maafa ya Halmashauri na
(viii) Kuratibu shughuli za Halmashauri zinazotekelezwa na taasisi nyingine kama vile sekta ya ardhi.

pages.menu_path: Administration > Division > Division of Pre-Primary and Primary Education
pages.title: Division of Pre-Primary and Primary Education
pages.text_en:
Department Objective
The objective of the Pre-Primary and Primary Education Department is to plan and oversee the implementation of laws, policies, documents, and guidelines related to the provision of Pre-Primary Education, Primary Education, Special Needs Education, Adult Education, and Non-Formal Education.
To achieve this objective, the Department performs the following functions:
Plan the availability, distribution, and utilization of resources in primary schools.
Supervise continuous assessment and national examinations in primary schools.
Oversee the provision of adult education and non-formal education at pre-primary and primary levels.
Coordinate life skills education in primary schools.
Conduct needs assessments for Special Education, Adult Education, and Non-Formal Education.
Provide advice on the establishment and development of Adult Education and Non-Formal Education centers.
Supervise the implementation of primary education plans and programs.
Develop and maintain a database for pre-primary and primary education.
Coordinate and supervise sports activities in primary schools.
The Department is headed by the Head of Department and consists of four (4) sections as follows:
Academic Section
Equipment and Statistics Section
Special Needs Education Section
Adult Education and Non-Formal Education Section
Academic Section
This section performs the following activities:
Coordinate the implementation of policies, plans, documents, and guidelines for pre-primary and primary education at the school level.
Coordinate and supervise the administration of continuous school assessments and national examinations for Standard Two (STNA) , Standard Four (SFNA) , and Standard Seven (PSLE) .
Monitor and evaluate the implementation of pre-primary and primary education plans.
Prepare reports on the implementation of education development plans and programs.
Coordinate education for self-reliance and supervise income-generating projects/activities in primary schools.
Equipment and Statistics Section
This section performs the following activities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret statistics for pre-primary and primary education.
Coordinate the availability, distribution, and utilization of educational resources in primary schools.
Prepare enrollment statistics and information on school equipment.
Prepare reports on the implementation of education development.
Identify school resource requirements within the Council.
Special Needs Education Section
This section performs the following activities:
Prepare and supervise implementation plans for special education at pre-primary and primary levels.
Identify children with special needs and assign them to appropriate schools.
Collect information on students with special needs and provide appropriate advice.
Coordinate the availability, distribution, and use of resources for special education.
Adult Education and Non-Formal Education Section
This section performs the following activities:
Prepare and supervise implementation plans for Adult Education and Non-Formal Education at pre-primary and primary levels.
Coordinate life skills education.
Conduct needs assessments for Adult Education and Non-Formal Education.
Provide advice on the establishment and development of Adult Education and Non-Formal Education training centers.
Coordinate the availability, distribution, and use of resources for Adult Education and Non-Formal Education.
The Department supervises 195 primary schools , of which 119 are government schools and 76 are privately owned schools .
pages.text_sw:
﻿Lengo la Idara
Lengo la Idara ya Elimu ya Awali na Msingi ni kupanga na kusimamia utekelezaji wa sheria, sera, nyaraka na miongozo kuhusu utoaji wa Elimu ya Awali, Msingi, Mahitaji Maalumu na Elimu Nje ya Mfumo Rasmi. Ili kufikia lengo hilo Idara inatekeleza majukumu yafuatayo:-
Kupanga upatikanaji, usambazaji na matumizi ya rasilimali katika shule za msingi;
Kusimamia upimaji endelevu na mitihani ya taifa ya shule za msingi;
Kusimamia utoaji wa elimu ya watu wazima na elimu isiyo rasmi katika ngazi ya awali na msingi;
Kuratibu elimu ya stadi za maisha katika shule za msingi;
Kufanya tathmini ya mahitaji ya Elimu Maalumu, Elimu ya Watu Wazima na Elimu Nje ya Mfumo Rasmi;
Kutoa ushauri kuhusu uanzishaji na uendelezaji wa vituo vya Elimu ya Watu Wazima na Elimu Nje ya Mfumo Rasmi;
Kusimamia utekelezaji wa mipango na programu za elimu ya msingi;
Kuunda na kutunza kanzidata ya elimu ya awali na msingi na
Kuratibu na kusimamia shughuli za michezo katika shule za msingi.
Idara hii itaongozwa na Mkuu wa Idara na itajumuisha sehemu nne (4) kama ifuatavyo:-
Sehemu ya Taaluma
Sehemu ya Vifaa na Takwimu
Sehemu ya Elimu ya Mahitaji Maalumu na
Sehemu ya Elimu ya Watu Wazima na Elimu Nje ya Mfumo Rasmi
Sehemu ya Taaluma
Sehemu hii inafanya shughuli zifuatazo:
Kuratibu utekelezaji wa sera, mipango, nyaraka na miongozo ya elimu ya Awali na Msingi katika ngazi ya shule;
Kuratibu na kusimamia usimamizi wa upimaji endelevu wa shule na mitihani ya kitaifa ya darasa la Pili (STNA), darasa la Nne (SFNA) na darasa la Saba (PSLE);
Kufuatilia na kutathmini utekelezaji wa mipango ya elimu ya awali na msingi;
Kutayarisha taarifa za utekelezaji wa mipango na programu za maendeleo ya elimu na
Kuratibu utoaji wa elimu kwa ajili ya kujitegemea na kusimamia shughuli/mradi wa kujiingizia kipato katika shule za Msingi.
Sehemu ya Vifaa na Takwimu
Sehemu hii inafanya shughuli zifuatazo: -
Kukusanya, kuchambua na kutafsiri takwimu za elimu ya awali na msingi
Kuratibu upatikanaji, usambazaji na matumizi ya rasilimali za elimu katika shule za msingi
Kuandaa takwimu za uandikishaji na vifaa vya shule
Kutayarisha taarifa za utekelezaji wa maendeleo ya elimu na
Kubainisha mahitaji ya rasilimali za shule katika Halmashauri.
Sehemu ya Elimu ya Mahitaji Maalumu
Sehemu hii inafanya shughuli zifuatazo:-
Kuandaa na kusimamia mipango ya utekelezaji wa elimu maalumu katika ngazi ya elimu ya awali na msingi;
Kutambua watoto wenye mahitaji maalumu na kuwapangia shule;
Kukusanya taarifa za wanafunzi wenye mahitaji maalumu na kushauri ipasavyo na
Kuratibu upatikanaji, usambazaji na matumizi ya rasilimali kwa ajili ya elimu maalumu.
Sehemu ya Elimu ya Watu Wazima na Elimu Nje ya Mfumo Rasmi
Sehemu hii inafanya shughuli zifuatazo: -
Kuandaa na kusimamia mipango ya utekelezaji wa Elimu ya Watu Wazima na Elimu Nje ya Mfumo Rasmi katika ngazi ya elimu ya awali na msingi.
Kuratibu elimu ya stadi za maisha.
Kufanya tathmini ya mahitaji ya Elimu ya Watu Wazima na Elimu Nje ya Mfumo Rasmi.
Kushauri kuhusu uanzishwaji na uendelezaji wa vituo vya mafunzo ya Elimu ya Watu Wazima na Elimu Nje ya Mfumo Rasmi.
Kuratibu upatikanaji, usambazaji na matumizi ya rasilimali kwa ajili ya Elimu ya Watu Wazima na Elimu Nje ya Mfumo Rasmi.
Idara inasimamia shule za msingi 195 ikiwa shule 119 ni za serikali na shule 76 ni za watu binafsi.

pages.title: Division of Infrastructure, Rural and Urban Development Planning
pages.text_en:
The Department has three (3) sections , namely:
Buildings
Roads
Mechanical and Electrical
The functions performed by each section are as follows:
1. Buildings
Supervising the construction of secondary schools, primary schools, ward offices, hospitals, dispensaries, and buildings for various government sectors .
Issuing building permits to institutions and individuals constructing buildings within Kibaha Town Council . Permits are issued to both those with surveyed plots and those whose plots have not been surveyed.
Providing technical advice on construction matters .
The department provides professional advice and inspects various building plans for people who wish to construct modern and quality houses .
Providing services for architectural drawing of building plans and cost estimation , including the preparation of construction cost estimates and structural drawings .
2. Roads
The section supervises the implementation and maintenance of roads by conducting various types of maintenance every year, including:
Routine maintenance
Spot improvement (repair of damaged sections)
Periodic maintenance
Opening of new roads in streets and in newly surveyed residential areas .
3. Mechanical and Electrical
This section performs the following functions:
Supervising road construction works using Council machinery .
Coordinating the leasing of machinery to private individuals .
Supervising the installation of electricity in new government buildings .
Carrying out electrical maintenance in government buildings that have electricity .
pages.text_sw:
Idara inavitengo vitatu (3) navyo ni
Majengo
Barabara
Mitambo na Umeme
Kazi zinazofanywa kwa kila kitengo ni kama inavyoonyeshwa hapa chini.
1.MAJENGO

2. Utoaji vibali vya ujenzi kwa taasisi na watu binafsi wanaojenga katika halmashauri ya Mji Kibaha vibali vinatolewa kwa wale waliopimiwa viwanja na ambao hawajapimiwa. .
3. Kutoa ushauri wa kiufundi katika masuala ya ujenzi
Tunatoa ushauri wa kitaalamu pamoja na ukaguzi wa ramani mbalimbali za watu wanaotaka kujenga nyumba bora na za kisasa.
4. Tunatoa huduma ya kuchora ramani pamoja na kufanya makisio yaani kuandaa gharama za ujenzi wa majengo, pamoja na kuandaa michoro ya kihandisi(structural drawings).

Matengenezo ya muda maalum

pages.title: Division of Community Development
pages.text_en:
Community Development Division
The Community Development Division is among the divisions within the Meru District Council and serves as an important link between the Council and the community by coordinating and supervising development activities.
The Community Development Division has a total of 15 staff members , including 10 men and 5 women , who provide services at both the district and ward levels . At the district headquarters , there are 7 staff members (3 men and 4 women) , while at the ward level there are 8 staff members (7 men and 1 woman) .
Objectives of the Community Development Division
To build the capacity of sustainable communities by empowering them to identify their needs, design, plan, implement, and manage development plans using available resources effectively, while generating and increasing income to improve the living standards of the community.
Structure of the Division
The Division has five desks , namely:
Economic Empowerment and Poverty Reduction Desk
HIV/AIDS Coordination Desk
Gender and Child Development Desk
Community Participation Desk
NGOs Coordination, Monitoring, and Registration Desk
The general responsibilities of the Division and its desks are as follows:
General Responsibilities of the Community Development Department
Engage the community in identifying opportunities and challenges affecting their development.
Educate the community to move away from beliefs, traditions, customs, and cultures that hinder development.
Engage and empower special groups to participate in development opportunities and processes to improve their welfare.
Coordinate the implementation and integration of gender issues in development programs and plans across various sectors.
Enable communities to utilize opportunities available in sectoral policies and strategies for development.
Enable citizens to benefit from economic opportunities.
Promote child rights and proper child care.
Facilitate registration, coordination, and monitoring of Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs).
Enable communities to identify, analyze, and prevent conflicts that hinder development.
Coordinate and promote community participation in cross-cutting issues.
Provide education on community rights and responsibilities and facilitate coordination and registration of legal aid service providers at the district level.
Educate communities on the benefits of major national development projects and the opportunities they create for local communities.
Responsibilities of the Desks
Economic Empowerment and Poverty Reduction Desk
Work with the Council Empowerment Committee to implement strategies for citizens’ economic empowerment.
Mobilize citizens to join SACCOS and VICOBA for savings and access to capital.
Analyze opportunities available in major investment and national projects and educate local communities so they can participate or gain employment.
Coordinate the provision of loans from 10% of the Council’s internal revenue for empowering women, youth, and people with disabilities.
Ensure the Council allocates special areas for economic investment such as agriculture, industries, and small and medium enterprises.
Monitor the implementation of economic investment activities in the Council and prepare implementation reports.
HIV/AIDS Coordination Desk
Provide VICOBA training for people living with HIV/AIDS .
Ensure the assessment of the HIV/AIDS situation in the Council is conducted and annual strategies are developed.
Provide reports on HIV/AIDS activities to the HIV/AIDS Committee meetings.
Review coordination reports from wards and streets and provide advice to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
Coordinate, monitor, and evaluate planned HIV/AIDS activities.
Identify and assess activities of stakeholders implementing HIV/AIDS interventions in the Council, including groups of people living with HIV and widows.
Ensure all HIV/AIDS plans and stakeholder activities are integrated into the Council and Regional HIV/AIDS Strategic Plans to avoid duplication of efforts and resources.
Ensure policies, national HIV/AIDS strategies, laws, guidelines, and research findings reach stakeholders and the community.
Provide advice to relevant authorities on policies or by-laws related to HIV/AIDS control.
Ensure the availability of an updated list of active HIV/AIDS stakeholders.
Gender and Child Development Desk
Coordinate child rights and development programs implemented by stakeholders to ensure compliance with government policies, laws, and regional and international conventions on child rights.
Educate families, communities, and stakeholders to invest in child care, early childhood development, and upbringing.
Coordinate stakeholders working on child-related programs to avoid duplication and misuse of resources.
Ensure violence against children is eliminated through national programs implemented with stakeholders.
Increase community awareness of child rights, protection, and welfare through public education using community radio, television, commemorations, meetings, and forums.
Coordinate the collection, updating, analysis, and dissemination of child-related data.
Coordinate the establishment and operation of Children’s Councils at village, ward, and district levels.
Coordinate the establishment and operation of family parenting groups at the community level.
Introduce and monitor the use of registers for child rights violations and their handling at village, ward, and council levels.
Ensure gender issues are recognized within the Council through gender analysis.
Ensure gender issues are incorporated into village, street, and council development plans.
Facilitate gender-related training based on needs.
Provide referrals for victims of gender-based violence to relevant institutions such as Social Welfare, Police, Lawyers, and Hospitals.
pages.text_sw:
Divisheni ya Maendeleo ya Jamii ni miongoni mwa divisheni zilizopo katika Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Meru , na ni kiungo muhimu kati ya Halmshauri na Jamii kwa kuratibu na kusimamia shughuli za kimaendeleo. Divisheni ya maendeleo ya jamii ina Jumla ya watumishi 15 ambapo wanaume 10 na wanawake 5 wanaotoa huduma kwa ngazi ya Wilaya na kata. Ambapo makao makuu ya willaya kuna watumishi 7 (me 3 ke 4) ngazi ya kata watumishi 8 (me 7 ke 1).
MALENGO YA DIVISHENI YA MAENDELEO YA JAMII
Kujenga uwezo wa jamii endelevu, kwa kuwezesha jamii katika kubaini mahitaji yao, kubuni, kuandaa, kutekeleza na kusimamia mipango ya kujiletea maendeleo kwa kutumia kikamilifu rasilimali zilizopo kwa kujipatia na kujiongezea kipato kwa kuimarisha hali ya maisha ya jamii.
MUUNDO WA DIVISHENI
Divisheni ina Madawati matano ambayo ni:- Dawati la uwezeshaji wananchi kiuchumi na kupunguza umaskini,Dawati la uratibu wa kupambana na maambukizi ya ukimwi, Dawati la maendeleo ya jinsia na mtoto, dawati la ushirikishwaji wa jamii na dawati la uratibu, ufuatiliaji na usajili wa mashirika yasiyo ya kiserikali NGOS. Majukumu ya jumla ya Divisheni na madawati husika yameainishwa kama ifuatavyo:
MAJUKUMU YA JUMLA YA DIVISHENI YA MAENDELEO YA JAMII .
Kushirikisha Jamii katika kuainisha fursa na changamoto zinazoikabili ili kulijiletea Maendeleo.
Kuelimisha Jamii kuondokana na Fikra, Imani, Mila, Desturi na Tamaduni Zinazokinzana na Maendeleo.
Kushirikisha Jamii katika Kuwaunganisha na Kuwawezesha makundi Maalum katika fursa na Mchakato wa Maendeleo ili kuinua ustawi wao.
Kuratibu Utekelezaji na Uzingatiaji wa Masuala ya Jinsia Katika Programu na Mipango ya Maendeleo Katika Sekta Mbalimbali.
Kuwezesha Jamii Kutumia Fursa ya Sera za Kisekta na Mikakati yake katika Kujiletea Maendeleo.
Kuwezesha Wananchi Kunufaika na Fursa za Kiuchumi.
Kuwezesha Jamii Kutekeleza Haki na Malezi ya Mtoto.
Kuwezesha Usajili, Kuratibu na Ufuatiliaji wa Mashirika Yasiyo ya Kiserikali
uwezesha Jamii Kutambua, Kuanisha na Kuzuia Migogoro inayoathiri Maendeleo katika Jamii
Kuratibu na Kuhamasisha Ushiriki wa Jamii katika Masuala Mtambuka.
Kutoa Elimu ya Haki na Wajibu wa Jamii na Kuwezesha Uratibu na Usajili wa Watoa Huduma za Msaada wa Kisheria Katika Ngazi Wilaya
Kuelimisha Jamii Faida za miradi mikubwa ya kitaifa Kwa maendeleo ya Taifa na fursa Kwa jamii
MAJUKUMU YA MADAWATI
DAWATI LA UWEZESHAJI WANANCHI KIUCHUMI NA KUPUNGUZA UMASKINI
Kushirikiana na Kamati ya Uwezeshaji ya Hamashauri kutekeleza Mkakati wa Uwezeshaji wananchi kiuchumi;
Kuhamasisha wananchi kujiunga na SACCOS na VICOBA kwa lengo la kujiwekea akiba na kupata mitaji;
Kuchambua fursa zilizoko katika Miradi mikubwa ya uwekezaji na miradi ya Kitaifa na kuelimisha wazawa ili waweze kushiriki/kuajiriwa;
Kuratibu utoaji wa mikopo inayotokana na asilimia 10% ya mapato ya ndani ya Halmashauri kwa ajili ya kuwezesha wanawake, vijana na watu wenye ulemavu;
Kuhakikisha Halmashauri inatenga maeneo maalum ya uwekezaji kiuchumi kama vile kilimo, viwanda na biashara ndogondogo na za kati; na
Kufuatilia utekelezaji wa shughuli za uwekezaji kiuchumi katika Halmashauri na kuandaa taarifa ya utekelezaji.
DAWATI LA URATIBU WA KUPAMBANA NA MAAMBUKIZI YA UKIMWI,
Mafunzo ya VICOBA kwa watu wanaoishi na virus vya UKIMWI(WAVIU)
Kuhakikisha tathmini ya hali halisi ya VVU na UKIMWI katika Halmashauri inafanyika na kuweka mikakati ya Kila mwaka.
Kuhamasisha kuunda
Kutoa taarifa za shughuli za VVU na UKIMWI kwenye kikao cha kamati ya UKIMWI
Kupitiaa taarifa za uratibu zinazofanywa na Kata na Mitaa ili kutoa ushauri wa namna ya kuimarisha na kuongeza ufanisi.
Kuratibu, kufuatilia na kutathmini utekelezaji wa shughuli za VVU na UKIMWI zilizopangwa.
Kutambua na kutathmini shughuli za wadau mbalimbali wanaotekeleza afua za VVU, na UKIMWI katika Halmashauri. Vikundi vya WAVIUna wajane.
Kuhakikisha mipango yote ya UKIMWI na wadau wanaotekeleza katika Halmashauri inaingizwa kwenye Mpango Mkakati wa UKIMWI wa Halmashauri na Mkoa ili kuondoa urudufu wa juhudi na rasilimali.
Kuhakikisha sera, Mkakati wa Taifa wa kudhibiti UKIMWI, sheria, Miongozo na matokeo ya tafiti mbalimbali ya masuala ya UKIMWI yanawafikia wadau na wananchi kwa ujumla.
Kutoa ushauri kwa ngazi inayohusika kuhusu Sera au sheria ndogo juu ya udhibiti wa VVU na UKIMWI.
Kuhakikisha uwepo wa orodha ya wadau hai wa Masuala ya UKIMWI.
DAWATI LA MAENDELEO YA JINSIA NA MTOTO
Kuratibu program za haki na Maendeleo ya Mtoto zinazotekelezwa na wadau ili kuhakikisha zinafuata Sera, Sheria za Serikali na Mikataba ya Kikanda na Kimataifa iliyolenga Haki za Mtoto.
Kuhamasisha na Kuelimisha familia, jamii na wadau katika kuwekeza kwenye malezi, makuzi na maendeleo ya awali ya mtoto ili kuwa na jamii bora iliyojengwa kwa misingi ya umoja na mshikamano wa kitaifa.
Kuunganisha nguvu za wadau mbali mbali wanaofanya kazi za watoto ili kuepusha migongano na matumizi mabaya ya rasilimali fedha na watu.
Kuhakikisha ukatili dhidi ya watoto unatokomezwa kupitia mipango na program za kitaifa ambazo zimeandaliwa kwa kushirikiana na wadau.
Kuongeza uelewa wa jamii kuhusu masuala ya haki, ulinzi na ustawi wa mtoto kupitia uelimishaji umma kwa kutumia vipindi vya redio za jamii, runinga, maadhimisho, mikutano na midahalo.
Kuratibu ukusanyaji, uhuishwaji, uchambuzi na usambazaji wa takwimu zinazohusu watoto.
Kuratibu uanzishwaji na uendeshaji wa mabaraza ya watoto katika ngazi ya kijiji, Kata, na Wilaya.
Kuratibu uanzishwaji na uendeshwaji wa vikundi vya malezi kwa familia katika ngazi ya jamii.
Kuanzisha na kufuatilia matumizi ya rejista ya matukio ya uvunjifu wa haki za watoto na namna yalivyoshughulikiwa katika ngazi ya kijiji, Kata na Halmashauri.
Kuhakikisha kuwa masuala ya jinsia katika Halmashauri yanatambuliwa kwa kufanya uchambuzi wa jinsia (gender analysis).
Kuhakikisha masuala ya jinsia yanaingizwa katika mipango ya vijiji, Mitaa na Halmashauri.
Kuwezesha mafunzo mbali mbali ya jinsia kwa kadri ya mahitaji.
Kutoa rufaa kwa wahanga wa ukatili wa jinsia (Ustawi wa Jamii, Polisi, Wanasheria na Hospitali).
DAWATI LA USHIRIKISHWAJI WA JAMII
Ushirikishaji jamii kutambua fursa na vikwazo kwa maendeleo ya jamii

pages.title: Division of Industry, Trade, and Investment
pages.text_en:
Main Objective
To coordinate and create a conducive environment for the development of industries, trade, markets, and investment within Meru District Council .
Department Responsibilities
The Department of Industry, Trade, and Investment performs the following functions:
Coordinate the implementation of policies, laws, regulations, and procedures related to industries, trade, markets, and investment.
Promote industries, trade, markets, and investment within the Council.
Plan and develop industrial areas and parks in collaboration with key stakeholders.
Plan industrial and trade attractions and promote investment.
Promote the development of Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) .
Develop investment proposals and projects.
Facilitate private sector development initiatives.
Establish and manage a database of industries, trade, markets, and investment.
Manage the One Stop Business Centre .
Conduct research to promote investment.
Coordinate the District Business Forum .
Supervise the operation of auctions and markets within the Council.
Implement the Business Development Strategy for small entrepreneurs and service providers.
Create a favorable environment for business and investment to stimulate economic growth.
Department Structure
The Department of Industry, Trade, and Investment is headed by the Head of Department and consists of two main sections :
Industrial Development and Investment Section
Trade and Markets Section
1. Industrial Development and Investment Section
This section handles the following activities:
Coordinate the implementation of policies, laws, regulations, and procedures related to the industrial and investment sector.
Promote and coordinate public-private partnerships.
Allocate, develop, and monitor industrial areas and parks.
Provide advice on industrial policy improvements and coordinate sectoral meetings.
Promote raw material production for industrial use.
Prepare and maintain registers of industries and economic enterprises.
Plan and estimate taxes for small-scale industries.
Develop and review investment profiles.
Promote investment from the private sector.
Coordinate and provide advisory services to investors.
Create an enabling environment for investors.
2. Trade and Markets Section
This section performs the following responsibilities:
Supervise the implementation of policies, laws, regulations, and procedures related to trade and markets.
Provide entrepreneurship training to the business community.
Coordinate and provide advice on business registration.
Analyze business and market data and provide appropriate recommendations.
Coordinate the District Business Council meetings .
Promote partnerships between the private sector and public sector.
Supervise the operations of auctions and markets within the Council.
Collect and disseminate market information for goods and services.
Implement strategies to promote trade among small traders and service providers.
Create a favorable business environment within the District.
pages.text_sw:
LENGO KUU
Kuratibu na kuweka mazingira rafiki kwa maendeleo ya viwanda, biashara, masoko, na uwekezaji ndani ya Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Meru.
MAJUKUMU YA IDARA
Idara ya Viwanda, Biashara na Uwekezaji inatekeleza majukumu yafuatayo:
Kuratibu utekelezaji wa sera, sheria, kanuni na taratibu zinazohusiana na viwanda, biashara, masoko na uwekezaji.
Kukuza viwanda, biashara, masoko na uwekezaji katika Halmashauri.
Kupanga na kuendeleza maeneo ya viwanda na hifadhi kwa kushirikiana na wadau wakuu.
Kupanga vivutio vya viwanda, biashara, masoko na kukuza uwekezaji.
Kukuza maendeleo ya Biashara Ndogo na za Kati (SMEs).
Kuendeleza mapendekezo na miradi ya uwekezaji.
Kuendeleza hatua za maendeleo ya sekta binafsi.
Kuanzisha na kusimamia kanzidata ya viwanda, biashara, masoko na uwekezaji.
Kusimamia kituo kimoja cha biashara (One Stop Business Centre).
Kufanya utafiti wa kukuza uwekezaji.
Kuratibu Jukwaa la Biashara la Wilaya.
Kusimamia shughuli za minada na masoko ndani ya Halmashauri.
Kutekeleza Mkakati wa Maendeleo ya Biashara kwa wafanyabiashara wadogo na watoa huduma.
Kuweka mazingira bora ya biashara na uwekezaji kwa ajili ya ukuaji wa uchumi.
MUUNDO WA IDARA
Idara ya Viwanda, Biashara na Uwekezaji inaongozwa na Mkuu wa Idara na inajumuisha sehemu mbili kuu:
Sehemu ya Maendeleo ya Viwanda na Uwekezaji
Sehemu ya Biashara na Masoko
1. SEHEMU YA MAENDELEO YA VIWANDA NA UWEKEZAJI
Sehemu hii inahusika na shughuli zifuatazo:
Kuratibu utekelezaji wa sera, sheria, kanuni na taratibu za sekta ya viwanda na uwekezaji.
Kukuza na kuratibu ubia kati ya sekta ya umma na sekta binafsi.
Kutenga, kuendeleza na kufuatilia maeneo ya viwanda na hifadhi.
Kutoa ushauri juu ya uboreshaji wa sera za viwanda na kuratibu mikutano ya kisekta.
Kukuza uzalishaji wa malighafi kwa matumizi ya viwandani.
Kutayarisha na kutunza rejista za viwanda na vitega uchumi.
Kupanga na kukadiria ushuru kwa viwanda vidogo.
Kuendeleza na kupitia upya wasifu wa uwekezaji.
Kukuza uwekezaji kutoka sekta binafsi.
Kuratibu na kutoa ushauri kwa wawekezaji.
Kuweka mazingira wezeshi kwa wawekezaji.
2. SEHEMU YA BIASHARA NA MASOKO
Sehemu hii inatekeleza majukumu yafuatayo:
Kusimamia utekelezaji wa sera, sheria, kanuni na taratibu za biashara na masoko.
Kutoa mafunzo ya ujasiriamali kwa jamii ya wafanyabiashara.
Kuratibu na kutoa ushauri kuhusu usajili wa biashara.
Kuchambua taarifa za biashara na masoko na kutoa ushauri stahiki.
Kuratibu kongamano la Baraza la Biashara la Wilaya.
Kukuza ubia kati ya sekta binafsi na sekta ya umma.
Kusimamia shughuli za minada na masoko ndani ya Halmashauri.
Kukusanya na kusambaza taarifa za masoko ya bidhaa na huduma.
Kutekeleza mkakati wa kukuza biashara kwa wachuuzi wadogo na watoa huduma ndogo.
Kuweka mazingira bora ya biashara ndani ya Wilaya.
